findings.text: follow-on: TestDatabaseMergeGraph only EXPLAINs FRONTS_DATABASE_DOCUMENTS_MERGE, so it proves the Cypher parses but not that the $database_sources[database] map lookup resolves a database name to its scanner source at runtime; a mis-keyed or unmapped database still EXPLAINs clean and would silently link nothing.

follow-on: mark_dynamic_handbook_pages runs unconditionally at the end of every ingest_pages and calls get_embed_model() and a facility-wide _chunk_rows scan even when no dynamic page exists, while ingest_page repeats the same scan per page, so the cost is O(pages x linking chunks) per ingest.

follow-on: the manifest's baseline_suite block is empty, so the base-arm result (103 passed at 8c60bdca9) survives only as prose in the tests: line and the fragment and no base gate log was retained; this review re-derived it, but the run's own record cannot be audited without a re-run.
